title: Jaxolotl: A Unified High-Performance Benchmark Suite for LTL-Based Multi-Task RL
title_zh: Jaxolotl: 一个统一的高性能基准套件用于基于 LTL 的多任务强化学习

paragraphs.en: Training agents to follow arbitrary instructions is an important goal of multi-task reinforcement learning (RL). Linear temporal logic (LTL) provides a precise and structured formalism for specifying instructions to agents, and has been successfully adopted for training generalist multi-task policies. However, differences in implementations, task distributions, and evaluation protocols make existing methods difficult to compare, while high computational costs limit the scale and statistical reliability of experiments. We introduce Jaxolotl , a unified high-performance benchmark suite for multi-task LTL-RL to address these concerns. 1 1 footnotemark: 1 Jaxolotl provides a modular, end-to-end JAX implementation of six representative algorithms and four environments, together with newly curated task suites and a standardised, statistically robust evaluation protocol. By precompiling symbolic task representations into static arrays, Jaxolotl enables fully JIT-compiled training and evaluation, achieving end-to-end speedups of up to 220 × 220\times and supporting controlled comparisons at substantially greater experimental scale. We use this framework to systematically evaluate existing approaches, revealing complementary strengths and limitations: general methods capable of non-myopic reasoning struggle as the number of propositions grows, while methods with stronger scaling rely on environment-specific assumptions and suffer from myopia.

paragraphs.en: Multi-task reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising approach towards training generalist agents that can complete diverse objectives. A central question in this setting is how to specify tasks (or instructions ) to the agent. While many works have explored natural language as an intuitive interface (e.g. Hill et al., 2020 ; Carta et al., 2023 ), there has been increasing interest in formal specification languages such as linear temporal logic (LTL; Pnueli, 1977 ). LTL specifies temporally extended tasks over atomic propositions , i.e. high-level Boolean features of the environment state, and is especially appealing due to its unambiguous semantics and compositional task structure.
paragraphs.zh: 多任务强化学习（RL）是一种有前景的方法，可用于训练能够完成多样化目标的通用智能体。 在这一设定中，一个核心问题是如何向智能体明确指定任务（或指令）。 尽管许多研究已探索将自然语言作为直观的交互界面（例如： Hill 等人，2020；Carta 等人，2023），但近年来对线性时态逻辑（LTL；Pnueli，1977）等形式化规范语言的兴趣日益浓厚。 LTL 用于规范基于原子命题的时序扩展任务，即环境状态的高层布尔特征，并因其无歧义的语义和可组合的任务结构而尤其具有吸引力。

paragraphs.en: Despite recent progress in multi-task LTL-conditioned RL ( Vaezipoor et al., 2021 ; Qiu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Jackermeier and Abate, 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Jackermeier et al., 2026 ) , it remains challenging to understand how different methods actually compare: existing evaluations rely on different environments, evaluation protocols, and low-level implementation details, making it difficult to draw general conclusions. As a result, it is unclear whether reported differences arise from algorithmic choices or from experimental setup. Systematic comparison is further hindered by the computational cost of experiments, which typically involve training RL agents for millions of steps in CPU-based environments, restricting evaluations to a few random seeds and limiting broad analyses.

paragraphs.en: We introduce Jaxolotl ( JAX - O ptimised L earning for O bjectives in T emporal L ogic) as a unified benchmark suite to address these shortcomings. Jaxolotl provides a modular, end-to-end JAX ( Bradbury et al., 2018 ) implementation of six representative algorithms and four environments, spanning high-dimensional navigation, continuous control, and object interaction. We precompile inherently symbolic task structures, such as finite automata and syntax trees, into static tensor representations to meet JAX’s strict requirements on static array shapes and functional control flow. This allows us to fully just-in-time (JIT) compile the entire training and evaluation loop, leading to end-to-end speedups of up to 220 × 220\times over reference implementations on hardware accelerators. These efficiency improvements enable controlled benchmarking at substantially greater experimental scale, such as training 10 independent seeds in under four minutes rather than 13.4 hours.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Jaxolotl（JAX - O ptimised L earning for O bjectives in T emporal L ogic），作为一个统一的基准测试套件，以解决这些不足。 Jaxolotl 提供了一套模块化的端到端 JAX（Bradbury 等人，2018）实现，包含六个代表性算法和四个环境，涵盖高维导航、连续控制和对象交互。 我们将本质上具有符号性的任务结构（如有限自动机和语法树）预编译为静态张量表示，以满足 JAX 对静态数组形状和函数控制流严格的要求。 这使得我们能够对整个训练和评估循环进行完全即时（JIT）编译，在硬件加速器上相比参考实现实现了高达 220 × 220\times 的端到端加速。 这些效率提升使得在更大实验规模上进行受控基准测试成为可能，例如，将 10 个独立种子模型的训练时间从 13.4 小时缩短到不到四分钟。

paragraphs.en: We use Jaxolotl to conduct an extensive controlled benchmark of existing methods, isolating aspects such as general task satisfaction, non-myopic reasoning, and scaling with the number of atomic propositions. Our experiments reveal complementary limitations in current approaches: general methods capable of non-myopic reasoning (i.e. reasoning about the entire task rather than individual subgoals) struggle to scale to environments with large numbers of propositions. Conversely, methods exhibiting stronger proposition scaling rely on environment-specific observation-reduction functions and suffer from myopia, preventing them from planning multiple steps ahead.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Jaxolotl 对现有方法进行了广泛受控的基准测试，并分别评估了任务整体满意度、非短视推理以及随原子命题数量变化的扩展能力等方面。 我们的实验揭示了当前方法的互补性局限：能够进行非短视推理（即对整个任务而非单个子目标进行推理）的一般方法，难以扩展到包含大量命题的环境。 相反，那些在命题扩展方面表现更强的方法则依赖特定于环境的观察-简化函数，并存在短视问题，导致它们无法规划多个步骤的未来行动。

paragraphs.en: LTL and related formalisms such as reward machines are widely used to specify single, fixed tasks for RL agents ( Hahn et al., 2019 ; Camacho et al., 2019 ; Toro Icarte et al., 2022 ; Voloshin et al., 2023 ; Hasanbeig et al., 2023 ) . We instead consider the multi-task setting, where a single policy is required to zero-shot execute arbitrary LTL instructions. Many approaches have been developed for this setting, which can be broadly categorised into decomposition-based and holistic methods. Decomposition-based methods break down LTL specifications into subgoals that can be completed one at a time by a goal-conditioned policy ( Araki et al., 2021 ; León et al., 2022 ; Qiu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . While this simplifies learning, it limits the agent’s ability to reason about the entire task and may lead to myopic behaviour. Holistic approaches instead condition the policy on broader task structure, for example by encoding the formula syntax tree ( Vaezipoor et al., 2021 ) or Büchi automaton sequences ( Jackermeier and Abate, 2025 ) . Recent work targets scaling to large proposition sets, via proposition-specific observation reduction ( Guo et al., 2025 ) or parameterised predicates ( Cloete et al., 2026 ) . While the field has seen rapid progress in recent years, it remains difficult to compare methods due to differences in environments, task distributions, and evaluation protocols. Our work builds on these existing LTL-based multi-task RL methods and unifies them within a single JAX framework.
paragraphs.zh: LTL 及相关形式化方法（如奖励机）被广泛用于为强化学习智能体指定单一、固定的任务（Hahn 等，2019；Camacho 等，2019；Toro Icarte 等，2022；Voloshin 等，2023；Hasanbeig 等，2023）。 我们转而考虑多任务设定，其中需要单个策略能够零样本执行任意的 LTL 指令。 针对这一设定，已有多种方法被开发出来，大致可分为基于分解的整体性方法。 基于分解的方法将 LTL 规范分解为子目标，这些子目标可以由一个以目标为条件的策略逐一完成（Araki 等，2021；León 等，2022；Qiu 等，2023；Liu 等，2024；Guo 等，2025）。 虽然这种方法简化了学习过程，但它限制了智能体对完整任务进行推理的能力，并可能导致短视行为。 整体性方法则通过以更广泛的任务结构来约束策略，例如通过编码公式语法树（Vaezipoor 等，2021）或 Büchi 自动机序列（Jackermeier 和 Abate，2025）。 近期的研究致力于将其扩展到大型命题集合，方法包括针对特定命题的观察简化（Guo 等，2025）或参数化谓词（Cloete 等，2026）。 尽管该领域近年来取得了快速进展，但由于环境、任务分布和评估协议的不同，比较不同方法仍然具有挑战性。 我们的工作基于这些现有的基于 LTL 的多任务强化学习方法，并将它们统一到一个单一的 JAX 框架中。

sents.en: Recent work targets scaling to large proposition sets, via proposition-specific observation reduction ( Guo et al., 2025 ) or parameterised predicates ( Cloete et al., 2026 ) .

sents.en: While the field has seen rapid progress in recent years, it remains difficult to compare methods due to differences in environments, task distributions, and evaluation protocols.

sents.en: Our work builds on these existing LTL-based multi-task RL methods and unifies them within a single JAX framework.
sents.zh: 我们的工作基于这些现有的基于 LTL 的多任务强化学习方法，并将它们统一到一个单一的 JAX 框架中。

paragraphs.en: Closest to our work, Guo et al. (2026) introduce SpecRLBench, a suite of environments and tasks for generalisation in multi-task LTL-RL. While SpecRLBench standardises several experimental settings, it relies on the methods’ original codebases, retaining differences in their training and evaluation pipelines. In contrast, Jaxolotl provides a unified implementation of six representative algorithms, together with a standardised evaluation protocol and curated task suites for controlled comparison. Furthermore, while SpecRLBench relies on CPU-based environments, Jaxolotl enables end-to-end training and evaluation on hardware accelerators, yielding orders-of-magnitude speedups over the reference algorithm implementations. These speedups make larger-scale, statistically robust benchmarking practical. Concurrent work ( Peng et al., 2026 ) evaluates VLA policies using LTL f monitors, but does not address multi-task LTL-RL methods.

paragraphs.en: The speedups enabled by end-to-end JIT-compiled training in JAX ( Lu et al., 2022 ) have spurred a broad ecosystem of accelerated environments ( Freeman et al., 2021 ; Lange, 2022 ; Bonnet et al., 2024 ; Matthews et al., 2024 ; Pignatelli et al., 2025 ; Zakka et al., 2025 ) and algorithm libraries ( Liesen et al., 2024 ; Rutherford et al., 2024 ) . Closest to our design, XLand-MiniGrid ( Nikulin et al., 2024 ) encodes procedurally generated symbolic rules and goals as fixed-size arrays to enable compiled multi-task training. paragraphs.en: Jaxolotl defines modular abstractions that allow implementing LTL-RL methods in terms of a generic task representation and policy architecture . Here, a task representation is the algorithm-specific data structure used to encode the current LTL instruction, such as a formula syntax tree ( Vaezipoor et al., 2021 ) , reach–avoid sequence ( Jackermeier and Abate, 2025 ) , or reach–avoid subgoal ( Guo et al., 2025 ) . As the agent interacts with the environment and completes parts of the task, this representation is generally updated online. A task encoder maps this representation to an embedding for the policy. The policy architecture further consists of an observation encoder to process environment observations, and a shared actor–critic module that outputs actions and value estimates based on the combined observation and task embeddings.
paragraphs.zh: Jaxolotl 定义了模块化抽象，使得 LTL-RL 方法能够基于通用的任务表示和策略架构来实现。 在此，任务表示是算法特定的数据结构，用于编码当前的 LTL 指令，例如公式语法树（Vaezipoor 等人，2021）、可达–回避序列（Jackermeier 和 Abate，2025）或可达–回避子目标（Guo 等人，2025）。 随着智能体与环境交互并完成部分任务，这种表示通常会在线更新。 任务编码器将该表示映射为策略所需的嵌入向量。 策略架构还包括一个观察编码器，用于处理环境观察信息，以及一个共享的演员–评论家模块，该模块基于融合后的观察和任务嵌入向量输出动作和价值估计。

paragraphs.en: JAX’s just-in-time (JIT) compilation achieves significant speedups by compiling Python code into XLA-optimised kernels for accelerators such as GPUs or TPUs. Jaxolotl follows the recent trend of JIT-compiling the entire training and evaluation loop ( Lu et al., 2022 ; Liesen et al., 2024 ) , rather than only the environment step function or policy network.

paragraphs.en: However, end-to-end compilation is considerably more challenging for LTL-RL than for standard RL workloads. The algorithms considered in this work manipulate symbolic objects whose structure depends on the sampled task, including formula syntax trees, automata with variable topology, and reach--avoid sequences with variable numbers of steps. These task representations are inherently dynamic and may change during environment interaction, directly conflicting with JAX’s strict requirements for static tensor shapes and control flow during JIT compilation. 2 2 2 See https://docs.jax.dev/en/latest/notebooks/Common_Gotchas_in_JAX.html for an overview.

paragraphs.en: Jaxolotl addresses this mismatch by extensively precompiling dynamic structures into static array representations, such as padded adjacency lists for formula graphs or padded transition tables for Büchi automata. Before training, we sample tasks for each curriculum stage, convert them into method-specific array representations, and pad all variable-sized components to fixed shapes. Task sampling and updating then reduce to simple array indexing operations, which are fully compatible with JIT compilation. We similarly precompute compact environment-reset descriptors to efficiently handle control flow under JIT, and compile evaluation formulae into static representations. The entire training and evaluation loops are therefore pure JIT-compiled functions, which further enables straightforward parallelisation across independent seeds via vmap .
paragraphs.zh: Jaxolotl 通过将动态结构广泛预编译为静态数组表示形式来解决这种不匹配问题，例如公式图的填充邻接表或 Büchi 自动机的填充转移表。 在训练之前，我们为每个课程阶段采样任务，将其转换为特定方法的数组表示形式，并将所有可变大小的组件填充为固定形状。 随后，任务采样和更新可简化为简单的数组索引操作，这些操作与 JIT 编译完全兼容。 我们同样预计算紧凑的环境重置描述符，以便在 JIT 下高效处理控制流，并将评估公式编译为静态表示形式。 因此，整个训练和评估循环都是纯 JIT 编译函数，这进一步使得通过 vmap 对独立种子进行直接并行化成为可能。

paragraphs.en: Deep RL algorithms are well-known to be sensitive to hyperparameter choices and random initialisation ( Henderson et al., 2018 ; Chan et al., 2019 ) , making meaningful comparisons between different methods challenging. Jaxolotl ’s computational efficiency allows increasing the number of independent training runs and evaluation episodes at marginal cost (see § 5.1 ), thereby improving estimates of expected performance and its uncertainty due to training randomness. We leverage this to provide a standardised evaluation protocol that adapts the general evaluation principles of Agarwal et al. (2021) to the generalist-policy setting.
paragraphs.zh: 众所周知，深度强化学习算法对超参数选择和随机初始化非常敏感（Henderson 等，2018；Chan 等，2019），这使得不同方法之间的有意义的比较变得困难。Jaxolotl 的计算效率允许以极低的成本增加独立训练运行的数量和评估回合的数量（见 §5.1），从而改善对预期性能及其因训练随机性而产生的不确定性的估计。我们利用这一点，提出了一种标准化的评估协议，该协议将 Agarwal 等（2021）提出的通用评估原则应用于通用策略场景。

paragraphs.en: In particular, Jaxolotl reports estimates of expected performance on a fixed set of benchmark tasks, together with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) over independent training runs. In contrast to conventional evaluation settings in which separate policies are trained for each task, each training run in our setting produces a single generalist policy that is evaluated on multiple tasks. This results in correlated scores across tasks, and we hence treat independently trained policies, rather than task-policy pairs, as the statistical units. Moreover, we deliberately use the arithmetic mean to aggregate performance across tasks, rather than a robust statistic such as the median or IQM ( Agarwal et al., 2021 ) . This ensures that potentially poor performance on difficult tasks is not discarded as outliers. Additionally, we provide per-task performance scores for fine-grained comparisons. We report two-sided 95% Student- t t CIs ( Student, 1908 ) over the resulting policy-level estimates. A full description of our evaluation protocol is provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 特别地，Jaxolotl 报告了在一组固定的基准任务上预期性能的估计值，以及独立训练运行中的 95% 置信区间（CI）。 与常规评估设置不同——在常规设置中，每个任务都会训练独立的策略——我们的设置中每次训练运行都会产生一个单一的通用策略，并在多个任务上进行评估。 这会导致不同任务之间的分数存在相关性，因此我们将独立训练的策略而非任务-策略对视为统计单位。 此外，我们特意使用算术平均值来汇总跨任务的性能，而不是使用中位数或 IQM（Agarwal 等人，2021）等稳健统计量。 这确保了在困难任务上可能较差的性能不会被当作离群值而舍弃。 另外，我们还提供每个任务的绩效分数，以实现更精细的比较。 我们对由此得到的策略级估计值报告了双尾 95% 的 Student-t CI（Student，1908）。 我们的评估协议的完整描述见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: We investigate the speed improvements enabled by Jaxolotl by comparing end-to-end training and evaluation times on ZoneEnv with original reference implementations. We focus on DeepLTL and GenZ-LTL, two representative methods with distinct task representations. All timings are measured on standard consumer hardware and include compilation overhead for the JAX implementations. See Section G.1 for full experimental details.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过比较 ZoneEnv 上使用原始参考实现与 Jaxolotl 进行端到端训练和评估所需的时间，来研究 Jaxolotl 带来的速度提升。 我们重点关注 DeepLTL 和 GenZ-LTL，这两种方法具有不同的任务表示方式，且均为代表性方法。 所有时间测量均在标准消费级硬件上进行，并包含了 JAX 实现的编译开销。 完整的实验细节请参见第 G.1 节。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 3 , our implementation yields speedups of 34 × 34\times and 47 × 47\times for training a single seed of DeepLTL and GenZ-LTL, respectively. This difference becomes even more pronounced as we increase the number of independent runs, achieving efficiency improvements of 102 × 102\times and 220 × 220\times for 10 seeds. This allows us to train 10 seeds of DeepLTL in 8.2 minutes and GenZ-LTL in 3.7 minutes, compared to 14.0 and 13.4 hours for the original implementations. We further observe significant speedups for evaluation, with 79 × 79\times and 34 × 34\times improvements for DeepLTL and GenZ-LTL, respectively. Section G.1 provides additional comparisons on raw environment throughput.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 3 所示，我们的实现分别使单个 DeepLTL 和 GenZ-LTL 种子的训练速度提升了 34× 和 47×。 随着独立运行次数的增加，这种差异变得更加显著：在 10 个种子的情况下，效率分别提升了 102× 和 220×。 这使得我们能够在 8.2 分钟内训练 10 个 DeepLTL 种子，并在 3.7 分钟内训练 10 个 GenZ-LTL 种子，而原始实现则需要 14.0 小时和 13.4 小时。 我们还观察到评估阶段的速度显著提升：DeepLTL 和 GenZ-LTL 分别获得了 79× 和 34× 的性能提升。 G.1 节提供了关于原始环境吞吐量的更多比较。

paragraphs.en: To validate the correctness of our implementations, we compare the performance of Jaxolotl against original reference implementations on ZoneEnv. Figure 4 compares final success rates across all methods (left), and training curves for DeepLTL and GenZ-LTL (right). The results demonstrate that our implementations closely match the references. While there are small differences in the training curves, these can be explained by minor low-level implementation details. Crucially, both overall learning behaviour and final success rates accurately reproduce the reference results. Further experimental details are provided in Section G.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了验证我们实现的正确性，我们在 ZoneEnv 上比较了 Jaxolotl 与原始参考实现的性能。 图 4 比较了所有方法的最终成功率（左），以及 DeepLTL 和 GenZ-LTL 的训练曲线（右）。 结果表明，我们的实现与参考实现的结果高度一致。 尽管训练曲线存在细微差异，但这些差异可以通过底层的实现细节来解释。 关键在于，整体的学习行为和最终的成功率都准确地复现了参考结果。 更多实验细节请参见第 G.2 节。

paragraphs.en: We proceed to systematically evaluate existing methods with Jaxolotl . Detailed training parameters are described in Appendix F . paragraphs.en: Standard GenZ-LTL uses domain-specific observation-reduction functions that map the current observation s t s_{t} into a task-relative representation, containing only features relevant for the current reach–avoid subgoal (see Appendix E ). We denote this configuration by GenZ-LTL † throughout figures and tables, and additionally evaluate GenZ-LTL (unreduced obs.) , which conditions on the full observation together with a one-hot encoding of the current subgoal, following Guo et al. (2025) . The standard reduction assumes that observations decompose into proposition-specific components and relies on a hand-designed fusion operator to produce fixed reach and avoid features. The unreduced variant removes these assumptions while retaining the rest of the method’s design, and is used when the assumptions do not hold, such as in Warehouse.
paragraphs.zh: 标准的 GenZ-LTL 使用领域特定的观察简化函数，将当前观察 s t s_{t} 映射为与任务相关的表示，其中仅包含与当前“到达-避免”子目标相关的特征（参见附录 E）。 我们在所有图表和表格中用 GenZ-LTL † 表示这种配置，并额外评估了 GenZ-LTL（未简化观察），该版本根据完整观察以及当前子目标的一热编码进行条件判断，遵循 Guo et al. (2025) 的方法。 标准简化方法假设观察值可以分解为特定命题的组成部分，并依赖人工设计的融合算子来生成固定的“到达”和“避免”特征。 未简化版本去除了这些假设，但保留了该方法其余的设计；当这些假设不成立时（例如在仓库场景中），会使用此版本。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 lists final aggregate results across all task suites, and Figure 5 shows training dynamics on finite-horizon tasks , which we focus on first. We observe that GenZ-LTL performs exceptionally well when provided with a suitable observation reduction function, achieving near perfect success rates. While its unreduced variant obtains high performance on LetterWorld and ZoneEnv, it struggles in more complex environments, where StructLTL dominates among the general methods. GCRL-LTL, DeepLTL, and SemLTL overall perform similarly, but GCRL-LTL is not applicable to Warehouse due to its limited avoidance heuristic (see Appendix E ). The early method LTL2Action is consistently outperformed by more modern approaches, showing a distinct gap in success rates.

paragraphs.en: We introduced Jaxolotl , a unified, high-performance benchmark suite for multi-task LTL-RL that enables controlled comparisons of existing methods at scale. Our evaluation shows that existing methods have complementary strengths and limitations. Methods that condition on the full task, such as StructLTL and DeepLTL, reason non-myopically, but, like all methods without observation reduction, they degrade as the number of atomic propositions grows. GenZ-LTL scales by exploiting a useful prior in the form of observation reduction, but this requires manual engineering, is not always applicable, and remains myopic. No evaluated method yet combines non-myopic reasoning, scaling to many propositions, and independence from environment-specific preprocessing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 Jaxolotl，这是一套统一且高性能的多任务 LTL-RL 基准测试套件，能够支持对现有方法的大规模受控比较。 我们的评估表明，现有方法各有其互补的优势和局限性。 那些以完整任务为条件的方法（如 StructLTL 和 DeepLTL）能够进行非短视推理，但与所有未采用观察简化的方法一样，随着原子命题数量的增加，其性能会下降。 GenZ-LTL 通过利用观察简化这一有用的先验知识实现了扩展性，但这需要人工设计，并非总能适用，且仍然具有短视性。 目前尚未有任何被评估的方法能够同时具备非短视推理、对大量命题的扩展能力以及对环境特定预处理的不依赖性。

paragraphs.en: Our task suites are finite and curated by hand to capture interesting behaviour, but some of our results may depend on the specific task families that we used. Jaxolotl currently only supports PPO training (as in the supported methods), although its abstractions are algorithm-agnostic. Other restrictions stem from the methods rather than the framework: LTL2Action does not support infinite-horizon tasks, GCRL-LTL and GenZ-LTL with observation reduction cannot be applied to Warehouse, and all methods assume known propositions (for GenZ-LTL, a known space of propositions) and an accurate labelling function with access to privileged state information.

paragraphs.en: We plan to extend Jaxolotl with off-policy algorithms and additional environments, particularly robotics domains such as contact-rich manipulation, and to scale the benchmark to larger proposition vocabularies and richer task distributions. paragraphs.en: A large body of work uses LTL to specify a single, fixed task to an RL agent. The standard approach translates the formula into an automaton, typically a limit-deterministic Büchi automaton (LDBA; Sickert et al., 2016 ), and learns a policy on the product of the MDP and the automaton ( Sadigh et al., 2014 ; Hasanbeig et al., 2018 ; Hasanbeig et al., 2023 ; Hahn et al., 2019 ; Bozkurt et al., 2020 ) . Subsequent work develops reward and discounting schemes with optimality guarantees ( Voloshin et al., 2022 ; Voloshin et al., 2023 ; Shao and Kwiatkowska, 2023 ) , improves exploration under the resulting sparse rewards ( Bagatella et al., 2025 ) , and characterises the fundamental limits of learning LTL objectives ( Yang et al., 2022 ) . Related work uses quantitative semantics of temporal logics as dense rewards ( Aksaray et al., 2016 ; Li et al., 2017 ; Jothimurugan et al., 2019 ) , or specifies tasks over finite traces ( Camacho et al., 2019 ; De Giacomo et al., 2019 ) . These methods learn a separate policy per specification, whereas we consider policies that generalise zero-shot to unseen specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 大量研究使用 LTL 为强化学习智能体指定单一且固定的任务。 标准方法是将公式转换为自动机，通常是极限确定性 Büchi 自动机（LDBA；Sickert 等，2016），并在马尔可夫决策过程与自动机的乘积上学习策略（Sadigh 等，2014；Hasanbeig 等，2018；Hasanbeig 等，2023；Hahn 等，2019；Bozkurt 等，2020）。 后续研究提出了具有最优性保证的奖励和折扣方案（Voloshin 等，2022；Voloshin 等，2023；Shao 和 Kwiatkowska，2023），改进了在由此产生的稀疏奖励下的探索能力（Bagatella 等，2025），并描述了学习 LTL 目标的基本极限（Yang 等，2022）。 相关研究将时态逻辑的定量语义用作密集奖励（Aksaray 等，2016；Li 等，2017；Jothimurugan 等，2019），或在有限轨迹上指定任务（Camacho 等，2019；De Giacomo 等，2019）。 这些方法为每个规格学习一个独立的策略，而我们则考虑能够零样本泛化到未见规格的策略。

paragraphs.en: Reward machines (RMs) expose the structure of a reward function as a finite-state machine ( Toro Icarte et al., 2018b ; Toro Icarte et al., 2022 ) , enabling counterfactual experience sharing across machine states and automated reward shaping. RMs can be constructed from formal specifications ( Camacho et al., 2019 ) , learned from experience ( Icarte et al., 2019 ; Xu et al., 2020 ) , composed hierarchically ( Furelos-Blanco et al., 2023 ) , or grounded in raw observations via neural relaxations ( Umili et al., 2024 ) . Since automata derived from LTL formulae can be viewed as RMs, many multi-task LTL-RL methods build on this perspective, although RM methods themselves typically target a single fixed machine.
paragraphs.zh: 奖励机器（RMs）将奖励函数的结构表示为有限状态机（Toro Icarte 等，2018b；Toro Icarte 等，2022），从而实现了跨机器状态的反事实经验共享和自动化奖励塑造。 RM 可以通过形式化规范构建（Camacho 等，2019），从经验中学习（Icarte 等，2019；Xu 等，2020），以分层方式组合（Furelos-Blanco 等，2023），或通过神经松弛方法基于原始观测建立（Umili 等，2024）。 由于从 LTL 公式派生出的自动机可被视为 RM，许多多任务 LTL-RL 方法都基于这一视角，尽管 RM 方法本身通常针对单个固定的机器。

paragraphs.en: Beyond formal languages, instruction-following agents have been conditioned on natural language, policy sketches, and subtask graphs ( Oh et al., 2017 ; Andreas et al., 2017 ; Sohn et al., 2018 ; Chevalier-Boisvert et al., 2019 ) ; see Luketina et al. (2019) for a survey. Natural language is flexible but ambiguous, whereas LTL provides precise semantics and automata that track task progress. Translating natural language into LTL is an active area of research ( Cosler et al., 2023 ; Fuggitti and Chakraborti, 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) , suggesting that LTL-conditioned policies can serve as a backbone for language-driven agents.
paragraphs.zh: 除了形式化语言之外，指令跟随智能体还基于自然语言、策略草图和子任务图进行了训练（Oh 等人，2017；Andreas 等人，2017；Sohn 等人，2018；Chevalier-Boisvert 等人，2019）；相关综述请参见 Luketina 等人（2019）。 自然语言虽然灵活但存在歧义，而 LTL 则提供了精确的语义和能够追踪任务进展的自动机。 将自然语言转化为 LTL 是当前活跃的研究领域（Cosler 等人，2023；Fuggitti 和 Chakraborti，2023；Liu 等人，2023），这表明基于 LTL 的策略可以作为语言驱动智能体的核心框架。

paragraphs.en: A complementary line of work satisfies temporal logic specifications with generative models trained on offline data, including diffusion-based planners guided by LTL ( Feng et al., 2024 ; Zoellner et al., 2026 ) , flow matching over graph-encoded specifications ( Meng and Fan, 2025 ) , and specification-conditioned decision transformers ( Guo et al., 2024 ) . paragraphs.en: We provide a brief overview of the four main environments supported in Jaxolotl .
paragraphs.zh: 我们简要介绍 Jaxolotl 支持的四种主要环境。

paragraphs.en: LetterWorld is a discrete navigation environment on a 7 × 7 7\times 7 grid on which 12 distinct letters are scattered, each appearing in two randomly chosen cells. The letters constitute the atomic propositions: a proposition holds exactly when the agent occupies a cell containing the corresponding letter, so every reachable assignment is a singleton set or the empty set. The agent starts each episode in a fixed corner cell and moves in the four cardinal directions via a discrete action space; the grid is toroidal, so moving across an edge wraps the agent around to the opposite side. The observation is an egocentric view of the entire grid, centred on the agent, encoded as one-hot letter channels plus an additional agent channel. Letter placements are resampled at the beginning of every episode, rejecting layouts in which some cell cannot be reached without crossing a letter; this guarantees that tasks requiring the avoidance of certain letters remain solvable.
paragraphs.zh: LetterWorld 是一个离散导航环境，运行在 7 × 7 的网格上，其中散布着 12 个不同的字母，每个字母出现在两个随机选择的单元格中。 这些字母构成了原子命题：当且仅当智能体占据包含对应字母的单元格时，该命题成立，因此所有可达的赋值都是单元素集合或空集。 智能体在每个回合开始时从一个固定的角落单元格出发，通过离散动作空间沿四个基本方向移动；网格是环形的，因此穿过边缘时，智能体会绕到对侧。 观察信息是以智能体为中心的全局网格视角，以智能体为中心进行编码，形式为独热字母通道加上一个额外的智能体通道。 每个回合开始时都会重新采样字母的放置位置，并拒绝那些存在无法在不跨越字母的情况下到达的单元格的布局；这确保了需要避开某些字母的任务仍然可解。

paragraphs.en: ZoneEnv consists of a bounded 6.6 × 6.6 ​ m 6.6\times 6.6\,\mathrm{m} plane containing eight non-overlapping circular zones of radius 0.4 ​ m 0.4\,\mathrm{m} , two of each of four colours. The colours form the atomic propositions: a proposition holds while the agent is inside a zone of the corresponding colour, and since zones never overlap, all reachable assignments are singletons or empty. The agent is a point robot that applies a forward force along its current heading and controls its angular velocity through a 2-dimensional continuous action space. Observations combine proprioceptive information (acceleration, velocity, and angular velocity) with a per-colour LiDAR that partitions the agent’s surroundings into 16 evenly spaced angular bins and reports an exponentially decaying signal based on the distance to the nearest zone of each colour in each bin. Both the zone layout and the initial agent pose are randomly sampled within a central 5 × 5 ​ m 5\times 5\,\mathrm{m} spawn area at the start of every episode, with zone centres kept at least 1.1 ​ m 1.1\,\mathrm{m} apart, and episodes terminate prematurely if the agent leaves the arena. Our implementation replaces the MuJoCo-based point robot of the original environment with lightweight point-mass dynamics that retain the original control interface.

paragraphs.en: FrankaZoneEnv is a 3D robotic manipulation environment in which a 7-DoF Franka Panda arm, simulated with MuJoCo XLA (MJX; Todorov et al., 2012 ), must visit coloured zones with its end effector. The 6-dimensional continuous action specifies Cartesian pose increments (up to 2 ​ cm 2\,\mathrm{cm} of translation and 0.1 ​ rad 0.1\,\mathrm{rad} of rotation per step) of the end effector, which a differential inverse-kinematics controller converts into joint-space position targets. Observations consist of arm proprioception (joint angles and velocities, the actual and commanded end-effector poses, and an inverse-kinematics feasibility flag) together with range–bearing information for every zone, i.e. the relative position of and distance to each sphere. The initial arm configuration is perturbed around a home pose with up to ± 0.15 ​ rad \pm 0.15\,\mathrm{rad} of per-joint noise, and the zone centres are resampled at the beginning of each episode. The number of colours is configurable, which makes the environment particularly suited to studying how methods scale with the number of propositions.

paragraphs.en: The Warehouse environment couples continuous navigation with object interaction. A point robot with the same dynamics as in ZoneEnv moves in a bounded 6.6 × 6.6 ​ m 6.6\times 6.6\,\mathrm{m} world containing four vases and four crates at randomised positions, along with three fixed axis-aligned rectangular regions: region A ( 2.2 × 2.2 ​ m 2.2\times 2.2\,\mathrm{m} ), region B ( 2.9 × 1.5 ​ m 2.9\times 1.5\,\mathrm{m} ), and a door area ( 1.6 × 0.8 ​ m 1.6\times 0.8\,\mathrm{m} ). The action space is hybrid: at every step, the agent applies a continuous (force, angular velocity) pair and simultaneously selects one of five discrete interactions (do nothing, pick up or drop a vase, pick up or drop a crate). An object can be picked up when the agent is within a radius of 0.2 ​ m 0.2\,\mathrm{m} of it, and a carried object is deposited at the agent’s current position when dropped, after which a 10-step cooldown prevents an immediate pickup. The five atomic propositions indicate whether the agent is inside each of the three regions and whether it is currently carrying a vase or a crate. In contrast to the other environments, multiple propositions can hold simultaneously (e.g. carrying both a vase and a crate while inside region A), giving rise to non-singleton assignments; since the regions are disjoint and at most one object of each type can be carried, 16 assignments are reachable in total. Observations comprise proprioception, the agent’s global position, a per-object-type egocentric LiDAR with 16 angular bins, direction vectors towards the three regions, and binary carrying flags. Episodes terminate prematurely if the agent leaves the world.

paragraphs.en: LTL2Action conditions the policy directly on the syntax tree of the LTL formula and keeps the task Markovian via formula progression ( Bacchus and Kabanza, 2000 ) : after every environment step, the formula is rewritten into an equivalent residual formula expressing what remains to be satisfied given the observed assignment, and the task counts as satisfied (or violated) once the formula progresses to ⊤ \top (or ⊥ \bot ). The syntax tree of the current formula is encoded with a relational graph convolutional network (RGCN; Schlichtkrull et al., 2018 ): every operator and proposition corresponds to a node with a learned embedding, and messages are passed from children to parents along three edge relations (unary operand, left and right binary operands) for a fixed number of rounds with shared weights, after which the embedding of the root node serves as the task embedding. Since messages only flow upwards, the number of message-passing rounds bounds the formula depth visible at the root, and must therefore be chosen to cover the deepest formulae in the task distribution. The policy is trained on randomly sampled reach–avoid formulae with a curriculum of increasing depth. Because progression only signals success for specifications that resolve to ⊤ \top after finitely many steps, LTL2Action does not support infinite-horizon tasks. In our implementation, the closure of each formula under progression is precomputed offline, reducing run-time progression to indexing a static transition table; at evaluation time, a new specification requires no further machinery, as the same progression mechanism applies unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: LTL2Action 将策略直接条件于 LTL 公式的语法树，并通过公式推进保持任务的马尔可夫性质（Bacchus 和 Kabanza，2000）：在环境的每一步之后，公式会被重写为一个等价的剩余公式，用以表达在已观察到的赋值下仍需满足的内容；一旦公式推进至 ⊤ \top（或 ⊥ \bot），任务即被视为满足（或违反）。 当前公式的语法树通过关系图卷积网络（RGCN；Schlichtkrull 等人，2018）进行编码：每个算符和命题都对应一个具有学习到的嵌入表示的节点，消息沿着三种边关系（一元操作数、左二元操作数和右二元操作数）从子节点向父节点传递固定轮数的共享权重迭代，之后根节点的嵌入表示即作为任务的嵌入表示。 由于消息仅向上流动，消息传递的轮数限制了根节点所能看到的公式深度，因此必须选择足够多的轮数以覆盖任务分布中最深的公式。 策略在随机采样的“可达–避免”公式上进行训练，并采用逐步增加深度的课程学习策略。 由于推进机制仅在规格经过有限步后解析为 ⊤ \top 时才表示成功，因此 LTL2Action 不支持无限时域任务。 在我们的实现中，每个公式在推进下的闭包都通过离线预计算完成，从而将运行时推进简化为对静态转换表的索引操作；在评估阶段，新的规格无需任何额外机制，因为相同的推进机制可保持不变地应用。

paragraphs.en: GCRL-LTL trains a goal-conditioned policy to reach individual atomic propositions, sampled uniformly at random and presented to the policy as a learned embedding of the goal proposition; no LTL formulae or curriculum are involved during policy training. Once the policy has been trained, a goal-conditioned value function (GCVF) is fitted in a second phase: it estimates the value of pursuing a new goal g ′ g^{\prime} from states encountered while travelling towards a goal g g , and, following the official implementation, is trained by regressing onto the critic’s value estimates along successful trajectories of the frozen policy.
paragraphs.zh: GCRL-LTL 训练一种以目标为条件的策略，使其能够达成单个原子命题；这些命题通过均匀随机采样获得，并以目标命题的学习嵌入形式呈现给策略。在策略训练过程中，不涉及任何 LTL 公式或课程学习机制。 策略训练完成后，在第二阶段中会拟合一个以目标为条件的价值函数（GCVF）：该函数用于评估从状态 g 向新目标 g ′ 推进时的价值；按照官方实现方案，它通过沿着冻结策略的成功轨迹，对批评者的价值估计进行回归训练。

paragraphs.en: At evaluation time, a given LTL specification is converted to an LDBA, and a depth-first search extracts candidate reach–avoid paths representing accepting runs from every automaton state, with accepting loops unrolled for infinite-horizon tasks. Whenever the automaton state changes, GCRL-LTL scores each candidate path by accumulating negative log-values along its subgoals—the first edge using the policy’s critic, and subsequent edges using the GCVF—and directs the goal-conditioned policy towards the first subgoal of the best-scoring path; ε \varepsilon -transitions of the LDBA are taken automatically whenever the plan calls for them. Avoidance is handled heuristically: if the value estimate for an avoid proposition is sufficiently high, the action that the policy would greedily take towards it is masked out of the action distribution. Since this masking operates on discrete action logits, GCRL-LTL runs on discretised variants of the continuous-control environments. The proposition-based avoidance heuristic furthermore does not translate to environments with more complex avoidance requirements, making GCRL-LTL not applicable to Warehouse.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估阶段，给定的 LTL 规范会被转换为一个 LDBA，随后通过深度优先搜索从每个自动机状态中提取候选的“可达-回避”路径，这些路径代表接受运行；对于无限时间范围的任务，接受循环会被展开。 每当自动机状态发生变化时，GCRL-LTL 会通过对各子目标沿路径累积负对数值来为每条候选路径打分——第一个边使用策略的批评器，后续边则使用 GCVF——并将目标条件策略引导至得分最高的路径的第一个子目标；只要计划需要，LDBA 中的 ε \varepsilon -转移会自动执行。 回避机制通过启发式方法处理：如果某个回避命题的价值估计足够高，那么策略原本会贪婪地朝向该命题采取的动作，则会被从动作分布中屏蔽掉。 由于这种屏蔽操作作用于离散动作的 logits，因此 GCRL-LTL 在连续控制环境的离散化变体上运行。 此外，基于命题的回避启发式方法无法适用于具有更复杂回避需求的环境，这使得 GCRL-LTL 不适用于 Warehouse 环境。

paragraphs.en: DeepLTL conditions the policy on sequences of reach–avoid pairs of assignment sets, which represent accepting runs of an LDBA and inform the policy of the subgoals that remain until satisfaction. Training requires no LTL formulae: the policy learns on randomly sampled reach–avoid sequences under a curriculum of increasing depth, including sequences that begin with an ε \varepsilon -transition and repeat their final element to capture stability ( 𝖥 ​ 𝖦 \mathsf{F}\,\mathsf{G}\, -type) tasks. To embed a sequence, each assignment is mapped to a learned embedding (with a dedicated token for ε \varepsilon -transitions), the reach and avoid sets of every step are pooled by a permutation-invariant deep sets network ( Zaheer et al., 2017 ) , and the resulting per-step representations are processed by a gated recurrent unit (GRU; Cho et al., 2014 ) traversed from the end of the sequence backwards, so that its final hidden state is aligned with the current subgoal. The ε \varepsilon -transitions of the LDBA, which resolve its non-determinism, are exposed to the agent as an additional binary action that advances the automaton without affecting the environment.
paragraphs.zh: DeepLTL 将策略条件化于可达–回避赋值集序列之上，这些序列代表 LDBA 的接受运行，并告知策略在达成目标前仍需完成的子目标。 训练过程无需任何 LTL 公式：策略通过随机采样的可达–回避序列进行学习，这些序列遵循深度递增的课程设置，包括以 ε \varepsilon -转移开始并通过重复其最后一个元素来捕捉稳定性（𝖥 ​ 𝖦 \mathsf{F}\,\mathsf{G}\, -类型）任务的序列。 为嵌入一个序列，每个赋值都会被映射到一个已学习的嵌入（其中 ε \varepsilon -转移使用专用标记），每一步的可达集和回避集会通过一个置换不变深度集合网络（Zaheer et al., 2017）进行池化，最终得到的每步表示会由一个门控循环单元（GRU；Cho et al., 2014）处理，该单元从序列末尾反向遍历，使其最终隐藏状态与当前子目标对齐。 LDBA 的 ε \varepsilon -转移用于解决其非确定性，这些转移被作为额外的二元动作暴露给智能体，该动作可推进自动机而不影响环境。

paragraphs.en: GenZ-LTL is a decomposition-based method that handles one reach–avoid subgoal at a time, where a subgoal consists of a single assignment to reach and a set of assignments to avoid. Instead of learning a task embedding, GenZ-LTL relies on hand-designed observation reduction functions that map the observation into a subgoal-relative form containing only the features relevant to the current subgoal, rendering the policy invariant to the number and identity of propositions. In ZoneEnv, for instance, the per-colour LiDARs are reduced to the LiDAR of the reach colour and an element-wise maximum over the LiDARs of the avoid colours; in LetterWorld, the per-letter grid channels are collapsed into a single channel marking reach and avoid cells; and in FrankaZoneEnv, the range–bearing features of the reach zone are retained alongside the avoid zones sorted by distance. This reduction assumes that observations decompose into proposition-specific components; where this does not hold, the unreduced variant conditions on the full observation together with one-hot encodings of the subgoal. The policy is trained on randomly sampled subgoals without a curriculum, using a safe-RL formulation: a Lagrangian-constrained variant of PPO in which a cost critic estimates the (maximum-based, reachability-style) probability of violating the avoid set, weighted against the reward objective by a state-dependent Lagrange-multiplier network.
paragraphs.zh: GenZ-LTL 是一种基于分解的方法，每次处理一个“到达-避免”子目标，其中每个子目标包含一个用于“到达”的单一赋值以及一组用于“避免”的赋值。 GenZ-LTL 不学习任务嵌入，而是依赖人工设计的观察简化函数，将观察值映射为与当前子目标相关的形式，仅保留与当前子目标相关的特征，从而使策略对命题的数量和身份保持不变。 例如，在 ZoneEnv 中，按颜色划分的激光雷达会被简化为“到达”颜色的激光雷达以及对“避免”颜色激光雷达的元素级最大值；在 LetterWorld 中，每个字母的网格通道会被合并为一个仅标记“到达”和“避免”单元的单通道；而在 FrankaZoneEnv 中，“到达”区域的距离-方位特征会与按距离排序的“避免”区域一同保留。 这种简化假设观察值可以分解为与特定命题相关的组件；当该假设不成立时，未简化的版本会将完整观察值与子目标的一热编码共同作为条件输入。 策略通过随机采样的子目标进行训练，且没有课程学习机制，采用的是一种安全强化学习框架：即 PPO 的一种拉格朗日约束变体，其中成本评判器会估计违反“避免”集合的（基于最大值的、可达性风格的）概率，并通过一个状态相关的拉格朗日乘子网络将其与奖励目标进行加权平衡。

sents.zh: 例如，在 ZoneEnv 中，按颜色划分的激光雷达会被简化为“到达”颜色的激光雷达以及对“避免”颜色激光雷达的元素级最大值；在 LetterWorld 中，每个字母的网格通道会被合并为一个仅标记“到达”和“避免”单元的单通道；而在 FrankaZoneEnv 中，“到达”区域的距离-方位特征会与按距离排序的“避免”区域一同保留。

sents.en: This reduction assumes that observations decompose into proposition-specific components; where this does not hold, the unreduced variant conditions on the full observation together with one-hot encodings of the subgoal.
sents.zh: 这种简化假设观察值可以分解为与特定命题相关的组件；当该假设不成立时，未简化的版本会将完整观察值与子目标的一热编码共同作为条件输入。

sents.en: The policy is trained on randomly sampled subgoals without a curriculum, using a safe-RL formulation: a Lagrangian-constrained variant of PPO in which a cost critic estimates the (maximum-based, reachability-style) probability of violating the avoid set, weighted against the reward objective by a state-dependent Lagrange-multiplier network.
sents.zh: 策略通过随机采样的子目标进行训练，且没有课程学习机制，采用的是一种安全强化学习框架：即 PPO 的一种拉格朗日约束变体，其中成本评判器会估计违反“避免”集合的（基于最大值的、可达性风格的）概率，并通过一个状态相关的拉格朗日乘子网络将其与奖励目标进行加权平衡。

paragraphs.en: At evaluation time, a specification is converted into an LDBA, and the first reach–avoid pair of every accepting run from the current automaton state yields the set of candidate subgoals. The agent selects the subgoal maximising the learned value minus the multiplier-weighted cost estimate, re-selects when the automaton state changes or a subgoal times out, and takes ε \varepsilon -transitions automatically whenever doing so is safe.
paragraphs.zh: 在评估阶段，一个规格会被转换为 LDBA，而当前自动机状态下的每个接受运行中第一个“可达–避免”对将产生候选子目标集合。 智能体选择能使已学习价值减去乘子加权成本估计值最大化的子目标；当自动机状态改变或某个子目标超时时会重新选择，并且只要安全就会自动执行 ε \varepsilon -转移。

paragraphs.en: SemLTL conditions the policy on semantic state labels of an LDBA. Each specification is compiled into a semantically labelled LDBA, in which every automaton state carries a feature vector summarising the semantics of its associated formulae; crucially, semantically equivalent states of different automata receive identical labels, which is what enables generalisation across specifications. The dimensionality of this label vector (the semantic input size) depends on the number of atomic propositions, and a single learned linear projection maps it to the task embedding. To resolve the non-determinism of the LDBA, the policy additionally receives the labels of all states reachable via ε \varepsilon -transitions, and a dedicated categorical action head chooses at every step between acting in the environment and jumping to one of the ε \varepsilon -successors. The policy is trained on sampled LTL formulae—including infinite-horizon 𝖦 ​ 𝖥 \mathsf{G}\,\mathsf{F}\, - and 𝖥 ​ 𝖦 \mathsf{F}\,\mathsf{G}\, -type tasks—under a curriculum of increasing complexity, receiving reward for accepting transitions of the automaton and a penalty for entering rejecting sink states. At evaluation time, a new specification is simply compiled into its semantically labelled LDBA and the policy acts directly on the resulting labels; no search or planning is involved.
paragraphs.zh: SemLTL 将策略的条件建立在 LDBA 的语义状态标签之上。 每个规格都会被编译成一个带有语义标签的 LDBA，其中每个自动机状态都携带一个特征向量，用于总结其关联公式的语义；关键在于，不同自动机中语义等价的状态会获得相同的标签，这使得跨规格的泛化成为可能。 该标签向量的维度（即语义输入大小）取决于原子命题的数量，而一个单一的已学习线性投影会将其映射到任务嵌入空间。 为了解决 LDBA 的非确定性，策略还会接收所有可通过 ε \varepsilon -转移可达的状态的标签，并在每一步通过一个专用的分类动作头，在作用于环境与跳转到某个 ε \varepsilon -后继状态之间做出选择。 该策略是在采样得到的 LTL 公式上进行训练的——包括无限视界的 𝖦 ​ 𝖥 \mathsf{G}\,\mathsf{F}\, 和 𝖥 ​ 𝖦 \mathsf{F}\,\mathsf{G}\, 类型任务——训练过程遵循一个复杂度递增的课程设置，当自动机接受转移时会获得奖励，而进入拒绝的汇点状态则会受到惩罚。 在评估阶段，新的规格只需被编译成其带有语义标签的 LDBA，策略便可直接对生成的标签进行决策；整个过程不涉及任何搜索或规划。

paragraphs.en: StructLTL conditions the policy on sequences of reach–avoid pairs of Boolean formulae over propositions, which represent the transitions along accepting runs of an LDBA: the reach formula is a conjunction of literals that characterises the transition to be taken, while the avoid formula is a disjunction of such conjunctions that must not be triggered. The encoder mirrors this logical structure hierarchically: propositions receive learned embeddings, with negation applied as a learned linear transform; a first deep sets module (the clause network) pools the literals of each conjunction; a second deep sets module (the disjunct network) pools the clause embeddings of each avoid formula; and the resulting per-step subgoal representations are combined by a single-head attention mechanism ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) in which the current subgoal attends over future ones, with a linear ALiBi position bias ( Press et al., 2021 ) whose slope controls how strongly attention is biased towards nearby subgoals. As in DeepLTL, training requires no LTL formulae: the policy learns on randomly sampled sequences of Boolean reach–avoid pairs under a curriculum, including ε \varepsilon -prefixed stability sequences, and ε \varepsilon -transitions are exposed as an additional binary action.
paragraphs.zh: StructLTL 将策略的条件建立在布尔公式的“可达-回避”对序列之上，这些公式作用于命题，表示 LDBA 接受运行中的状态转移：可达公式是字段的合取式，用于描述需要执行的状态转移；而回避公式则是此类合取式的析取式，必须避免被触发。 编码器以分层方式反映了这种逻辑结构：命题获得学习到的嵌入表示，否定操作则通过一个学习到的线性变换实现；第一个 deep sets 模块（子句网络）对每个合取式中的字段进行池化；第二个 deep sets 模块（析取网络）对每个回避公式的子句嵌入进行池化；最终，每一步的子目标表示由一个单头注意力机制（Vaswani et al., 2017）整合，其中当前子目标会关注未来的子目标，并使用具有线性 ALiBi 位置偏置（Press et al., 2021）的机制，其斜率控制着注意力对邻近子目标的偏好强度。 与 DeepLTL 类似，训练过程不需要任何 LTL 公式：策略在课程学习框架下，基于随机采样的布尔“可达-回避”对序列进行学习，其中包括以 ε \varepsilon 为前缀的稳定性序列，而 ε \varepsilon -转移则被作为额外的二元动作引入。

Having been trained on arbitrary formula sequences, the policy generalises across automata and therefore across LTL specifications.

paragraphs.en: All methods in Jaxolotl instantiate the same modular policy architecture, assembled from interchangeable components configured per environment. An observation encoder (“Env Net” in the tables of Section F.3 ) maps the environment observation to a feature vector: in LetterWorld, a convolutional network processes the egocentric grid channels, whereas in every other environment the observation is flattened and passed through a multi-layer perceptron (MLP; Rumelhart et al., 1986 ). In parallel, the method-specific task encoder of Appendix E (“LTL Encoder”) produces an embedding of the current task representation. The observation features and task embedding are concatenated into a joint representation on which both the actor and the critic operate; the two encoders are thus shared, while the actor and critic themselves have no common parameters. The critic is an MLP mapping the joint representation to a scalar value estimate. The actor is an MLP whose final hidden layer feeds one linear head per parameter group of the action distribution. GenZ-LTL deviates from this pattern only in that it has no task encoder: its observation reduction (see Appendix E ) injects the subgoal into the observation itself, so the joint representation coincides with the encoded (reduced) observation; in the unreduced variant, one-hot encodings of the reach and avoid assignments are appended to the flattened observation before encoding. All linear layers are initialised with orthogonal weights and zero biases.
paragraphs.zh: Jaxolotl 中的所有方法都实例化了相同的模块化策略架构，该架构由根据环境配置的可互换组件组装而成。 观察编码器（F.3 节表格中的“Env Net”）将环境观察映射为一个特征向量：在 LetterWorld 中，卷积网络处理以自我为中心的网格通道；而在所有其他环境中，观察值会被展平并通过多层感知器（MLP；Rumelhart 等，1986）。 同时，附录 E 中的方法特定任务编码器（“LTL Encoder”）会生成当前任务表示的嵌入。 观察特征和任务嵌入被拼接成一个联合表示，演员和评论者均基于此进行运算；因此这两个编码器是共享的，而演员和评论者本身没有共同参数。 评论者是一个 MLP，它将联合表示映射为一个标量值估计。 演员是一个 MLP，其最后一层隐藏层为动作分布的每个参数组提供一个线性输出头。 GenZ-LTL 仅在这一模式上有所不同：它没有任务编码器；其观察简化过程（见附录 E）将子目标注入到观察本身中，因此联合表示与编码后的（简化后的）观察一致；在未简化的变体中，在编码前会将“到达”和“避免”分配的一热编码附加到展平的观察上。 所有线性层均使用正交权重和零偏置进行初始化。

paragraphs.en: The actor heads follow the action space of the environment. In LetterWorld and ConveyorWorld, as well as in the discretised environment variants on which GCRL-LTL operates, a single head outputs the logits of a categorical distribution over the discrete actions. In ZoneEnv, ZoneEnv-NM, and FrankaZoneEnv, two heads output the mean and the state-dependent standard deviation of a diagonal Gaussian, with a softplus transformation guaranteeing positivity of the latter. In Warehouse, whose hybrid action space pairs a continuous control input with a discrete interaction, the Gaussian heads are complemented by a categorical head, and the resulting distributions are treated as independent factors of a joint distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的头跟随环境的动作空间。 在 LetterWorld 和 ConveyorWorld 中，以及在 GCRL-LTL 所运行的离散化环境变体中，单个头会输出一个离散动作上的分类分布的对数几率。 在 ZoneEnv、ZoneEnv-NM 和 FrankaZoneEnv 中，两个头会输出一个对角高斯分布的均值和状态相关的标准差，其中软加函数确保了后者为正。 在 Warehouse 中，其混合动作空间将连续控制输入与离散交互配对，高斯头由一个分类头补充，而最终得到的分布被视为联合分布的独立因子。

paragraphs.en: Methods that expose the ε \varepsilon -transitions of the LDBA to the agent extend the actor with dedicated heads. In DeepLTL and StructLTL, an additional scalar head defines a Bernoulli distribution over taking the ε \varepsilon -action, masked out whenever no ε \varepsilon -transition is available in the current automaton state; if the ε \varepsilon -action is taken, the sampled environment action is discarded and only the automaton advances. In SemLTL, the analogous head is instead evaluated once per ε \varepsilon -successor—on a joint representation formed from the observation features and the projected semantic label of that successor—and once on the current state, yielding a masked categorical distribution that selects between jumping to one of the ε \varepsilon -successors and acting in the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 将 LDBA 的 ε-转移暴露给智能体的方法，通过专用头来扩展了演员。 在 DeepLTL 和 StructLTL 中，一个额外的标量头定义了在采取 ε-动作上的伯努利分布；当当前自动机状态没有可用的 ε-转移时，该分布会被屏蔽。如果采取了 ε-动作，则采样得到的环境动作将被丢弃，只有自动机会向前推进。 在 SemLTL 中，类似的头则改为在每个 ε-后继上评估一次——基于由观察特征和该后继的投影语义标签组成的联合表示——并在当前状态上评估一次，从而产生一个经过屏蔽的分类分布，用于在跳转到某个 ε-后继或在环境中采取行动之间进行选择。

paragraphs.en: Two methods maintain auxiliary networks alongside the actor and critic. GenZ-LTL, trained with the Lagrangian-constrained variant of PPO, adds a cost critic with the same structure as the critic, together with a state-dependent Lagrange-multiplier network whose softplus activation keeps the multiplier non-negative; both operate on the same encoded observation as the actor. GCRL-LTL fits its goal-conditioned value function as an entirely separate model comprising its own observation encoder and goal-embedding table: the encoded observation is concatenated with the embeddings of the currently pursued and the prospective goal propositions and mapped to a scalar value by an MLP.
paragraphs.zh: 两种方法在智能体（actor）和评论家（critic）旁边维护辅助网络。 GenZ-LTL 使用带有拉格朗日约束的 PPO 变体进行训练，它添加了一个与评论家结构相同的成本评论家，以及一个依赖于状态的拉格朗日乘子网络，其 softplus 激活函数确保乘子非负；两者都与智能体基于相同的编码观测值运行。 GCRL-LTL 将其目标条件化的价值函数作为一个完全独立的模型进行拟合，该模型包含自己的观测编码器和目标嵌入表：编码后的观测值与当前追求的目标以及预期目标命题的嵌入向量拼接，并通过一个多层感知器（MLP）映射为一个标量值。

paragraphs.en: A curriculum in Jaxolotl is a sequence of stages, each of which defines a distribution over tasks via a sampler (or a mixture of samplers with associated probabilities). Since sampled tasks are dynamic Python objects, curricula are precomputed: before training, we draw a fixed number of tasks per stage and convert them into the method-specific static array representation. At the beginning of each episode, a task is then sampled uniformly at random from the precomputed samples of the current stage. If sampling is expensive (as for SemLTL, which compiles every sampled formula into an LDBA), the precomputed curriculum is generated once and cached on disk.
paragraphs.zh: Jaxolotl 中的课程是一系列阶段，每个阶段都通过采样器（或带有相关概率的采样器组合）定义任务分布。 由于采样任务是动态的 Python 对象，因此课程需要预先计算：在训练之前，我们会为每个阶段抽取固定数量的任务，并将其转换为特定方法的静态数组表示形式。 在每个回合开始时，系统会从当前阶段的预计算样本中均匀随机地采样一个任务。 如果采样成本较高（例如 SemLTL，它会将每个采样的公式编译为 LDBA），则预计算的课程会生成一次并缓存到磁盘上。

paragraphs.en: The agent progresses through the stages based on a stage frontier shared across all parallel environments. We track the success rate at the frontier stage over a rolling window of recently completed episodes, where an episode counts as successful if it terminates with positive reward. The frontier advances once this rate exceeds the threshold of the current stage, provided that the window has been filled and that a minimum fraction of environments has contributed episodes at the frontier (this prevents a small number of environments from dominating the estimate). Environments behind the frontier do not switch immediately: after each training rollout, a lagging environment advances one stage with a fixed adoption probability, so that the training distribution shifts gradually.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体根据所有并行环境共享的阶段边界，在各个阶段中逐步推进。 我们通过最近完成的一系列回合的滚动窗口，追踪边界阶段的成功率；若一个回合以正奖励结束，则视为成功。 一旦该成功率超过当前阶段的阈值，且窗口已填满、同时至少有最低比例的环境在边界阶段贡献了回合，边界便会向前推进（此举可防止少数环境主导估计结果）。 位于边界之后的环境不会立即切换：每次训练展开后，落后环境会以固定的采用概率推进一个阶段，从而使训练分布逐渐转移。

paragraphs.en: The task distributions reflect the task representation of each method. DeepLTL and StructLTL are trained on reach–avoid sequences, where later stages increase the sequence depth and the number of reach and avoid propositions per step, and additionally include reach–stay tasks in environments with infinite-horizon specifications. For StructLTL, the reach and avoid components are Boolean formulae drawn from environment-specific pools rather than single assignments; the two methods share identical curricula in several environments. LTL2Action and SemLTL sample LTL formulae from templates of the corresponding families (sequenced reach and reach–avoid objectives, as well as reach–stay objectives for SemLTL), such that all curriculum-based methods are trained on comparable task distributions. In all cases, the samplers ensure that sampled tasks are feasible, e.g. by never sampling a reach objective that is already satisfied by the preceding step. As discussed in Section 4.4 , GenZ-LTL and GCRL-LTL are trained on a single stage without progression, which samples uniformly random reach–avoid subgoals and goal propositions, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 任务分布反映了每种方法的任务表示方式。 DeepLTL 和 StructLTL 在“到达-回避”序列上进行训练，其中后续阶段会增加序列的深度以及每一步中“到达”和“回避”命题的数量，并在具有无限时间范围规格的环境中额外加入“到达-保持”任务。 对于 StructLTL，“到达”和“回避”组件是从特定环境池中提取的布尔公式，而非单一赋值；在多个环境中，这两种方法共享相同的课程设置。 LTL2Action 和 SemLTL 从对应类别的模板中采样 LTL 公式（包括序列化的“到达”和“到达-回避”目标，以及 SemLTL 的“到达-保持”目标），从而确保所有基于课程的方法都在可比较的任务分布上进行训练。 在所有情况下，采样器都会确保所采样的任务是可行的，例如，绝不会采样一个在前一步中已被满足的“到达”目标。 如第 4.4 节所述，GenZ-LTL 和 GCRL-LTL 在没有进展的单阶段中进行训练，分别均匀随机地采样“到达-回避”子目标和目标命题。

paragraphs.en: All timing experiments were run on a single desktop machine with consumer hardware: an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti GPU (16 GiB VRAM), an Intel Core i5-13600K CPU, and 32 GiB of RAM. For the comparison in Figure 3 , Jaxolotl trains multiple seeds in parallel on the GPU by vectorising the training loop over seeds with vmap . The reference implementations train a single seed per run. Running two reference instances concurrently increases their overall throughput, whereas running more reduces it due to resource contention. For each number of seeds k k , we therefore report the fastest wall-clock time in which each implementation produces k k trained seeds, and measure evaluation times in the same way. Timings for Jaxolotl include JIT compilation.
paragraphs.zh: 所有计时实验均在配备消费级硬件的单台桌面计算机上运行：NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti GPU（16 GiB VRAM）、Intel Core i5-13600K CPU 和 32 GiB RAM。 在图 3 的比较中，Jaxolotl 通过 vmap 将训练循环向量化到多个种子，从而在 GPU 上并行训练多个种子。 参考实现每次运行仅训练一个种子。 同时运行两个参考实例会提高其总体吞吐量，而运行更多实例则会因资源竞争导致吞吐量下降。 因此，对于每个种子数量 k，我们报告每种实现生成 k 个训练好的种子所需的最快实际运行时间，并以相同方式测量评估时间。 Jaxolotl 的计时结果包含了 JIT 编译的时间。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 compares raw environment throughput, measured in environment steps per second (SPS) over 8,192 steps of each parallel environment. Jaxolotl batches environments on the GPU with vmap , whereas the reference implementations run each environment in a separate process and step them asynchronously. We evaluate Jaxolotl with up to 2,048 parallel environments and the references with at most 128, since larger numbers caused them to crash. At its largest setting, Jaxolotl is between 35 × \times (FrankaZoneEnv) and 5,010 × \times (ZoneEnv) faster than the best reference measurement. paragraphs.en: While many of the methods studied are capable of non-myopic reasoning in principle, reasoning over many steps becomes difficult to learn in practice once exploration and credit assignment are non-trivial. To demonstrate, we evaluate them on k k -step variants of the original ConveyorWorld environment ( Abate et al., 2026 ) , of which ConveyorWorldSimple- k k ( Section 5.2.2 ) is a simplification. The task structure is the same: the agent must commit to one of two one-way conveyor belts leading to rooms A A and B B before satisfying 𝖥 ⁡ ( 𝗉 1 ∧ 𝖥 ⁡ ( 𝗉 2 ∧ ⋯ ∧ 𝖥 ​ 𝗉 k ) ) \mathsf{F}\,(\mathsf{p}_{1}\land\mathsf{F}\,(\mathsf{p}_{2}\land\dots\land\mathsf{F}\,\mathsf{p}_{k})) with 𝗉 i ≠ 𝗉 j \mathsf{p}_{i}\neq\mathsf{p}_{j} , where 𝗉 1 , … , 𝗉 k − 1 \mathsf{p}_{1},\dots,\mathsf{p}_{k-1} are accessible in both rooms and 𝗉 k ∼ U ⁡ ( { 𝖺 , 𝖻 } ) \mathsf{p}_{k}\sim U(\{\mathsf{a},\mathsf{b}\}) is accessible only in room A A (for 𝖺 \mathsf{a} ) or B B (for 𝖻 \mathsf{b} ). Unlike the simplified version, the agent must first explore the starting room to reach the belts, and then explore the room it arrives in to enter the grid tile associated with each proposition in order from 𝗉 1 \mathsf{p}_{1} to 𝗉 k \mathsf{p}_{k} before receiving any reward. Figure 8(a) provides a visualisation of ConveyorWorld- k k .

paragraphs.zh: 图 8(b) 展示了 ConveyorWorld 中成功率的 k 分布；随着 k 的增加，所有非短视方法的成功率都出现了严重下降。 对于每个种子，训练策略的性能呈现三峰分布：部分种子学会了任务并实现了 100% 的成功率，另一些则陷入局部最优，始终进入同一个房间，其余的则在训练预算内从未学会利用任何奖励（例如持续停留在初始房间）。 随着 k 的增加，探索与信用分配变得更具挑战性，因此分布通常从第一峰经第二峰逐渐转移至最后一峰，因为智能体必须按顺序访问所有 k 个子目标才能获得任何奖励。 需要注意的是，使用多阶段课程并未提升性能，因为在第一阶段课程中，许多种子甚至未能学会简单的 𝖥 ​ 𝗉 k \mathsf{F}\,\mathsf{p}_{k} 到达任务。
